breaking_news.headline: Is it a renter's market? It depends on where you live
breaking_news.summary: About 40% of rentals on Zillow offer move-in deals, like a month of free rent, thanks to a construction boom that created an apartment surplus in some parts of the United States.

breaking_news.headline: Survey confirms the struggle of working parents: 'No way to be two things at once'
breaking_news.summary: A new Pew survey finds many working parents feel they cannot give 100% at either work or home. Benefits like paid sick leave and more affordable childcare could help.

breaking_news.headline: The war with Iran is making oil changes pricier. And a deal won't solve it
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. may be the world's biggest producer of crude oil, but that's not the case for motor oil. The cost of lubricants is soaring, and even a tentative deal to end the war won't solve the problem.

breaking_news.headline: Shipping exec says industry needs assurances Strait of Hormuz will be safe
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang talks with Jakob Larsen, chief safety and security officer at BIMCO, the global shipping association, about what it might mean to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

breaking_news.headline: With Iran deal, Trump told ships to 'start your engines.' That's not happening yet
breaking_news.summary: Iran's control of the Strait of Hormuz inflicted global pain during the months-long conflict with the U.S. and Israel. A tentative deal is in place, but questions remain about the key waterway.

breaking_news.headline: Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady and hints at rate hike later this year
breaking_news.summary: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rates unchanged Wednesday, and signaled its next move could be a rate increase. It's the first rate decision under the new Fed chairman, Kevin Warsh.

breaking_news.headline: Here's how much the Iran war cost -- and how its effects will linger
breaking_news.summary: More than three months after the U.S. and Israel launched their war on Iran, the costs and aftereffects are felt around the world.

breaking_news.headline: Poll: Most Americans have the summer blues about Trump and the economy
breaking_news.summary: A new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds a record low share of Americans approve of President Trump's job performance and his handling of the economy heading into the summer before a key midterm election.

breaking_news.headline: Japan ramping up defence is 'critical' to prevent war, Defence Minister Koizumi tells BBC
breaking_news.summary: Japan needs to revisit the pacifist posture that has defined it since World War Two, Shinjiro Koizumi says.

breaking_news.headline: First Russian shadow fleet vessel enters Channel since Smyrtos boarding
breaking_news.summary: Forwarder, a Russian-flagged ship which left port in Primorsk last week, entered the Channel on Wednesday evening.

breaking_news.headline: Lawyer in high-profile Ugandan treason case charged with related offence
breaking_news.summary: Uganda's military chief had boasted of "the hurt and pain" he would inflict on Erias Lukwago, who was arrested earlier this week.

breaking_news.headline: British man dies in paragliding accident in Spain
breaking_news.summary: Authorities in Catalonia confirmed that the 63-year-old died in the Palau de Noguera area on Wednesday.

breaking_news.headline: Gunfire and explosions heard at Niger capital's airport
breaking_news.summary: Niger has been fighting a militant Islamist insurgency for a decade and in January suspected jihadists attacked the same airport.

breaking_news.headline: Suspected gang leader shot dead in flower bouquet ambush at airport
breaking_news.summary: The gunmen concealed their weapons behind flowers and stuffed toys while waiting for the victim outside Guayaquil airport.

breaking_news.headline: Moscow hit by largest Ukrainian attack since start of Russia's full-scale war
breaking_news.summary: A refinery and a shopping centre were burning after almost 200 Ukrainian drones struck an area to the south-east of the Russian capital.

breaking_news.headline: What's in the US-Iran agreement?
breaking_news.summary: The 14-paragraph memo includes an end to fighting, an agreement that Iran will never have a nuclear weapon, and a $300bn redevelopment package for Iran.

breaking_news.headline: Inflation unexpectedly steady as food price rises slow
breaking_news.summary: Higher petrol prices were offset by slower price rises for meat, dairy and vegetables, according to the ONS.

breaking_news.headline: Driving test wait time target will not be met until autumn next year
breaking_news.summary: The Transport Secretary had been aiming to reduce the backlog to seven weeks by this autumn.

breaking_news.headline: Warsh to review how Fed works after holding US interest rates at first meeting
breaking_news.summary: The Federal Reserve held rates between 3.5% and 3.75% after Kevin Warsh's first meeting in charge of the central bank.

breaking_news.headline: 'We had to get out of the way': The backlash over delivery robots
breaking_news.summary: As the delivery vehicles increasing take to US streets, bans and protest groups are springing up.
